title: Editable monthly savings breakdown
changes: Replaced the former percentage split tool with a popup from the budget savings field
Individual destinations have user-editable names, shekel amounts, sliders, add and delete controls
Destination amount changes update the primary monthly budget savings value, while manual changes to the primary value never alter destination amounts
Previous allocation settings migrate to amount-based version 2 without dropping names
Financial budget savings cap is respected and UI remains paginated without scrolling
